title: Send money to Rwanda, Cameroon, Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire with Grey
summary: Grey now lets you send money to Rwanda, Cameroon, Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire through local bank accounts and mobile money wallets.
body_markdown:
You already use Grey to receive, hold and manage your money. Now, we’re giving you more places to send it too.


Have family in Rwanda? Someone you need to pay in Cameroon? Or maybe you regularly send money to Senegal or Côte d’Ivoire?


You can now do it directly from Grey.


We’ve added Rwandan francs (RWF), Central African CFA francs (XAF) and West African CFA francs (XOF), so you can send money to people in these four countries using their local bank account or mobile money wallet, depending on the destination.


It’s one more way to use the money you already have in Grey, without having to move it somewhere else first.


Here’s where you can send money and how.


## Send Rwandan francs directly to a bank account


Need to send money to someone in Rwanda? You can now[send Rwandan francs (RWF) from Grey](https://grey.co/money-transfer/rwanda) directly to their local bank account.


Bank transfers are available to personal and business accounts across operating banks in Rwanda, so your recipient can get the money in the account they already use.


Transfers cost a flat $1.30 and are processed within 24 hours.


You can send between RWF 1,000 and RWF 5,000,000 in a single transaction.
That gives you plenty of flexibility, from sending a little money home to covering a larger expense or paying someone you work with.


## Send money to mobile wallets in Cameroon


In Cameroon, mobile money is part of everyday life. So instead of asking someone to use a different way to receive your money, you can[send it to a wallet](https://grey.co/money-transfer/cameroon) they already use.


Grey now lets you send Central African CFA francs (XAF) to:


- MTN Mobile Money
- Orange Money


Transfers are almost instant and cost a flat $1.80.


You can send from XAF 500 up to XAF 400,000 in a single transaction.


So, if your family needs money for an urgent expense or you need to pay someone in Cameroon, you can send it straight to their mobile wallet without waiting for a traditional international bank transfer.


## More ways to send money to Senegal


If you’re[sending money to Senegal](https://grey.co/money-transfer/senegal) , you can now choose between a bank account and several popular mobile money wallets.


You can now send West African CFA francs (XOF) to personal and business accounts across operating banks in Senegal.


You can also send money to:


- E-Money
- Free
- Expresso
- Orange
- Wave
- Wizall Money


**Bank transfers cost a flat $2, while mobile money transfers cost $3.**


Mobile money transfers are almost instant. Bank transfers are processed on the same business day, Monday to Friday, when sent before the 12:00 GMT cut-off time.


You can send between XOF 1,000 and XOF 1,500,000 per transaction.


That means the person receiving your money can choose what works best for them, rather than having to open a new account or change how they normally manage their money.


## Send money to Côte d’Ivoire by bank or mobile money


Grey is also making it easier to[send West African CFA francs (XOF)](https://grey.co/money-transfer/cote-divoire) to Côte d’Ivoire.


You can send directly to a local bank account or choose one of these mobile money options:


- MTN
- Orange
- Moov


Mobile money transfers cost a flat $1.80 and are almost instant. Bank transfers cost $2 and are processed on the same business day from Monday to Friday when sent before the 12:00 GMT cut-off time.


The minimum amount is XOF 1,000, and you can send up to XOF 1,500,000 per transaction.


So, from helping family with everyday expenses to sending money to someone you work with, you have different ways to get it to them.


## Send from the money you already have in Grey


You don’t need to already have RWF, XAF or XOF in your Grey account before sending.


You can start with money in your USD, EUR or GBP balance, choose who you want to send money to and enter the amount. Grey converts it into the recipient’s local currency as part of the process.


Before you confirm, you’ll be able to review the details of your transfer.


This means the money you receive and keep in Grey can now go further across Africa, without needing to move it through several different services first.


## More places, more ways to send with Grey


Your next transfer could be for family, work or something that wasn’t even on your radar yesterday. Whatever takes your money across borders, you now have more ways to send it with Grey.


With RWF, XAF and XOF now supported, you can send money to Rwanda, Cameroon, Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire through local bank accounts or mobile money, depending on the destination.


Open Grey and make your first transfer today.


## Frequently asked questions


### Can I send money to Rwanda with Grey?


Yes. You can send Rwandan francs (RWF) directly to personal and business bank accounts in Rwanda. Transfers cost $1.30 and are processed within 24 hours.


### Can I send money to Cameroon with Grey?


Yes. You can send Central African CFA francs (XAF) to MTN and Orange mobile money wallets in Cameroon. Transfers cost $1.80 and are almost instant.


### How can I send money to Senegal with Grey?


You can send West African CFA francs (XOF) to a local bank account or mobile money wallet in Senegal. Supported mobile money options include E-Money, Free, Expresso, Orange, Wave and Wizall Money.


### How can I send money to Côte d’Ivoire with Grey?


You can send West African CFA francs (XOF) directly to a local bank account or to MTN, Orange or Moov mobile money wallets.


### Do I need to have RWF, XAF or XOF in my Grey account first?


No. You can send using money from your supported Grey balances, including USD, EUR and GBP. The money is converted into the local currency when you send it.


### How long does it take for the money to arrive?


It depends on the country and how you send it. Mobile money transfers to Cameroon, Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire are almost instant. Bank transfers to Rwanda are processed within 24 hours, while eligible bank transfers to Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire are processed on the same business day, subject to the stated weekday cut-off time.


### How much does it cost to send money?


Fees depend on the destination and how the recipient gets the money. Rwanda bank transfers cost $1.30, Cameroon mobile money transfers cost $1.80, and transfers to Senegal and Côte d’Ivoire range from $1.80 to $3.


You’ll be able to review your transfer details before confirming.
